title: Law to expand city ban on enforcing reproductive care restrictions
summary: This bill would broaden an existing law barring city resources from being used to enforce restrictions on abortion, extending protection to all reproductive health care, including fertility treatments like IVF. It would bar city employees or property from being used to detain people for receiving such care or to share information identifying patients with out-of-state agencies, unless care was not performed legally. It takes effect immediately upon passage.
